images.title: Reading the date from 291
images.purpose: Shows how subtracting 165 from the answer 291 leaves 126, whose last two digits are the day and the digit before is the month.
images.composition: A short left to right flow: the answer, an arrow, the result split into a month box and a day box.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, generous empty margins, the main object large and centred. Top centre, small: the expression 100M + 165 + D in dark text. Middle row, left to right: the number 291 large in dark text; one right pointing grey arrow with − 165 written above it; then the number 126 drawn as two boxes side by side touching: a left box with teal (#0072B2) outline holding the digit 1, and a right box with amber (#E69F00) outline holding the digits 26. Under the teal box the word month in teal; under the amber box the word day in amber. Exactly 2 boxes and 1 arrow; no calendar, no people.

images.takeaway: Take away 165: the last two digits are the day, the rest is the month.
